changes.comment: COT tool rows show what the runtime said about the call: the row title is the runtime's summary (with a verb for read/list/search/edit rows and the tool name for rows without an action), the row carries the documented built-in icon for its action (bash/read/write/search), raw JSON arguments are no longer written into a titled row, and the expanded result shows the invocation as a code segment before the output. Result code segments now use the documented code field.
